Corrects my round-7 claim: B7-1/B7-2 alone could only reach 7.943. Not satisfied. No full-9, competitor or whole-suite claim.

findings.evidence: Embedded ::placeholder rule; live 6.1926:1 light / 7.4845:1 dark on the three placeholders; visible in editor-desktop-dark, navigation-desktop-dark, pages-mobile-dark.
Divider 1x24 between Eraser and Undo ink (aria-hidden); Work queue inbox path; section-add now 40x40 bordered. Section-add is still not the page-add control: see B8-1.

findings.severity: blocker for scoped 8 (Notes), regression introduced by the B7-2 fix
findings.title: Section-add and page-add are near-miss copies of one control
findings.evidence: Live computed: section-add radius 12px (`.icon-button` squircle rule at styles.css:186, not overridden by `.section-tabs .section-add`) vs page-add 8px (`.list-actions .icon-button` uses --ky-control-radius at :506); section glyph is NavIcon in `.nav-icon{color:var(--ink)}` (:488) vs page-add fullwidth '＋' in ink-strong. Visible at 1x in editor-desktop L/D and pages-mobile L/D.
findings.fix: Give both the same glyph and ink, and the shared radius: e.g. add `border-radius: var(--ky-control-radius)` and `color: var(--ink-strong)` to `.section-tabs .section-add` (and its .nav-icon), or render page-add with the same NavIcon plus. CSS only; no handler, order or label change.

findings.evidence: Parent-traced, corroborated by Sol6/7; not re-tested by me. Scoped impact: on phone, the first page opened from the no-open-note list leaves focus on BODY, so a keyboard or screen-reader user must Tab back into the page; later picks focus the title; no content or save risk. Blocks any keyboard/focus acceptance claim; does not change the visual scores.
